## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 30.05.2026 - 30.05.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer melden Zuverlässigkeitsprobleme. Das zeigt Qualitätslücken, die Wettbewerber nutzen können.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _quietvest_, 30.05.2026, 5/5: "I have been using this app for years. It is useful, elegant, and flawless. It lets me adapt it for exactly the types of habits I am trying to maintain (or break!) and doesn’t come loaded down with a bunch of unnecessary junk. It has never glitched or had bugs. Would recommend it to anyone trying to form a daily habit or track how well they’re maintaining one. As an additional bonus, it provides graphs of how you’re doing over various periods of time that you can explore when you want. Again, a perfect app."

## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 27.04.2026 - 27.04.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _AmandaL30_, 27.04.2026, 5/5: "This app is subtly brilliant. I love the weak view. It feels more motivating than just checkboxes and seeing today. Three habits for free and no annoying ads or premium reminders. I’ve tried a lot of habit apps and this one is simpler but my favorite. Shout out to having nice color themes for free too!"
